entities.summary: Brunei Revolt, a transformative movement in Brunei (1962–1984). Emerged from Brunei Revolt against proposed merger with Malaysia suppressed with British help and Omar Ali Saifuddien III. Catalyzed Brunei achieves full independence from the United Kingdom and Brunei joins ASEAN as its sixth member.
